title: ::: PSS-OFF 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ Passoff Reading 116 ]

blocks.text: When riding on buses, trains, and other public transportation, speak in a quiet or normal conversational tone, and try to avoid extended phone conversations. Loud, animated conversations can annoy others. Keep your wireless ringer as low as practical to avoid disturbing others. Keep your phone close and easily accessible if you're expecting an important call. If you must take an important phone call but are in a(n) inappropriate surrounding, such as during lectures, and concerts, set the phone to vibrate mode and answer the phone only after leaving the room.
